sites.name: Zrir Siziman, the Promise Stones (V2)
sites.storm: storm-dusk at its worst: dust sheets and gusts; landmarks read as silhouettes through the haze
sites.story: B03 the promise: G03_PROMISE frames the High Voice crown in the notch above the gap; the Keeper reads the inscription (RADIO_B03_01)
sites.style: bazaar stone: two unequal inscribed stones stood upright, chocked, with a worn paving before them
sites.layout:
==== road (aims at the mountain 430-540 m) ====  way-stone at 482.9 (left 4.8 m): the path leaves the road beside it
        path -> [worn paving: where people stood to read]
   cairn [SHORT x1.5, downhill]  <- 5 m gap, square to the G03 eye; the crown in the notch ->  [TALL x2.2, inscribed] cairn
        packing stones round both bases; the last flower at the tall stone
     rock (behind, downhill)                                   rock (behind)
   ... the hollow falls away left; the High Voice 2.9 km beyond the gap ...
sites.notes: Story set V2 on the road site S04_PromiseStones. The V1 cairns (S04_PromiseStones_000..010) are removed by `clear`. The stones stand left of the road on the crown bearing from the G03 mid-hold eye, not the storyline's left 8 m / right 6 m (which cannot frame the crown). The glance target moves into the gap (`hooks`). Nothing religious, nothing modern.
story_owned: V2 the Promise Stones (this file is the story set)
